title: Risk parity from scratch
dek: Allocating by risk contribution instead of capital — building, validating, and backtesting the all-weather portfolio blueprint.
excerpt: A 25%-each portfolio is only diversified in dollars — in risk terms, three of the four assets carry almost everything. We solve the equal-risk-contribution weights with SciPy, validate them against Riskfolio-Lib to 1e-6, and backtest risk parity against 60/40 and equal weight over 2010–2024 — ending at the leverage debate the results force.
